subject.title: fix: fall back on raw provider request errors

question: Should OpenClaw treat the generic `invalid_request_error` type as a shared `format` failover signal for all providers that expose it, rather than limiting this recovery to Anthropic-shaped raw bodies?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately shared and changes the fallback outcome for existing configured models; only an owner can confirm that this provider-neutral semantic is the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Approve the shared mapping
options.body: Accept `invalid_request_error` as a provider-neutral format signal after the existing specific classifiers, then land after a current-main refresh.

options.title: Narrow the mapping
options.body: Restrict the raw-body mapping to an explicit provider or documented response contract if generic provider semantics are not intended.

options.title: Pause for provider policy
options.body: Leave the PR open until provider-routing owners define which structured request errors may advance a model fallback.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared mapping
recommendation.body: Accept `invalid_request_error` as a provider-neutral format signal after the existing specific classifiers, then land after a current-main refresh.
